hiddenChapters.name: The hidden anime chapter (Valefor at Besaid, anime style)
hiddenChapters.route: real keys from the title, the word gear typed on the board, the advisor card for ten decisions (Wins/playFight), headless Playwright, PYREFLY_BROWSER=gpu, 1600x900, seed 1, https://echoesofspira.com/

CHK-026.reason: The chapter is 3D: the ww3d cel-shaded stage with skinned figures (docs/handoff/ch-anime.md). CHK-026 judges the head and feet of a painted figure across a swap of painted planes; this chapter draws no painted pose plane and has no registration, so there is no swap to judge. A 3D figure changes pose by an animation blend, which CHK-027 reads.

CHK-027.method: frame difference of the game canvas, 192x108 luma, every presented frame, two captures of 60.0 and 61.9 s (3,579 and 3,688 frames at 59.6 fps), 10 real decisions each; NOT the painted-plane harness (it cannot follow a skinned figure)
CHK-027.reason: One party-wide one-frame step in each capture, at the same moment (4.7 to 4.8 s, about a second before the first decision, Power Break by Paine, is logged): the three girls change shape and position in a single frame while the camera and Valefor do not move (the edge map of each girl correlates 0.26 to 0.52 with the frame before, a quiet pair reads 0.96 to 0.99, and the boss reads 0.86 to 0.91 as before); the best matching shift is 67 to 92 px at 1600 wide (low correlation, not a rigid slide), and the next frame matches the one after it (0.96 to 0.98): a persistent change in one frame with no in-between frame, which is the snap CHK-027 item 1 names. It repeats exactly, so it is the game and not the sampler. One in each 60 s capture, against 0.25 a minute allowed, and the step is over the 40 px line. Not attributed to a pose clip: the instrument cannot name the figure part or the cause; the first-time-fan lens or the rig lane should look at the first turn.
CHK-027.notCounted: A whole-picture change at 17.2 to 17.5 s in each capture (every box of the frame, the boss included, drops to 0.34 to 0.58 correlation and comes back): a camera cut or framing jump, read as a camera cut and not counted, as the owner brief says for cuts.
CHK-027.limits: It cannot see a double image, cannot size a jerk in feet or head pixels (the 67 to 92 px is an edge-map best shift of low confidence), and a fast designed move is not told from a slide; the verdict is the weaker instrument's and is labelled so. Frame pacing in the captures: p99 16.8 ms, worst 66.7 and 216.6 ms (shared GPU).
